jobs.title: HVAC & Cold Chain Mobile Implementation Advisor (f/m/x) – Brussels - MSF Belgium
jobs.description:
**CONTEXT**

At MSF, Logistics aims to provide a safe, functional, and effective care environment for our patients, the populations we assist, and our teams through a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. Our work involves engineering appropriate solutions that connect medical activities (grouped into Logistics Intervention families) and operational and contextual parameters with technical expertise in medical equipment management, construction, shelter, energy, HVAC, cold chain, motorized fleet, telecommunications, GIS, air operations, and more. Given the diversity and constant evolution of MSF’s operations, Logistics teams are continuously adapting and innovating to meet complex and shifting needs.

The mission of the HVAC team in MSF OCB (Operational Center Brussels) is to design and manage HVAC systems that ensure thermal comfort, optimal air quality, and reduced airborne infection risks in health facilities, while promoting energy efficiency and safeguarding medical stocks by maintaining precise environmental controls in medical warehouses, specifically within the 15°C to 25°C range.

The mission of the Cold Chain team in MSF OCB is to safeguard the integrity of temperature-sensitive medical items in diverse temperature ranges, including refrigerated and ultra-low temperature storage by providing safe, reliable and context adapted solutions for active and passive cold chain infrastructure, equipment, and processes, empowering medical teams to deliver high quality care.

The MIO HVAC and Cold Chain position is related to the fact that MSF’s medical activities require continuous support to ensure a healthy, safe, and suitable environment for patients, medical staff, and supplies by delivering the appropriate temperature, humidity, and indoor air quality conditions.

The MIO HVAC and Cold Chain is part of the Log Support Unit (LSU) under the line management of the Energy & HVAC Team Leader.

As **MIO HVAC and Cold Chain**, you aim to implement or improve practices in MSF projects for an effective and efficient design, management, and use of HVAC and active cold chain equipment, ensuring proper air quality and comfort conditions.

- You contribute to the Energy, HVAC & Cold Chain Team Leader by giving feedback on the functional status of the HVAC and Cold Chain conditions in running projects
- You support the OCB projects in all technical aspects related to the management of HVAC and Cold Chain
- You will be able to provide first-line support to the MSF projects and coordinate with the Energy & HVAC Team Leader to improve and implement the MSF process, tools, and related techniques. You will proactively evaluate and propose solutions in line with their technical domain.
- You assist in implementing HVAC and Cold Chain settings in starting or running projects regarding technical needs, human resources, training, and external contractors according to the MSF framework

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Provide specialized 1st line support**

- Support the Logistics Teams on HVAC and Cold Chain design, installation, use, maintenance, and decommissioning
- Support the evaluation of HVAC and Cold Chain setups and propose new solutions to improve them where necessary. In addition, support the implementation of the MSF protocols, tools, and techniques related to HVAC and Cold Chain
- Support the development of competencies of the Project technical focal point through HVAC and Cold Chain content-based training
- Support the development of competencies in Cold Chain management for the country and project responsible
- Support the Logistics teams on functional, active cold chain installation according to the needs (including cold room installation and qualification)
- Evaluate the possibilities and advantages of collaboration with other technical families: construction, Water & sanitation, health facility management, pharmacy, vaccination referents, and Biomedical equipment when applicable

**Provide specialized 2nd line support**

- Support the Logistics teams at project level in the evaluation of external suppliers, maintenance contracts, local purchases, and outsourced HVAC and Cold Chain services and equipment such as chillers, air conditioners, central heating systems
- Support the Logistics teams at project level in resolving interdisciplinary technical issues affecting the optimal functionality of the HVAC and Cold Chain conditions concerning electrical or water supply, infrastructural concerns, and infection control matters, among others
- Contribute to ensuring that each/most of the 2nd-line support has an impact on the 3rd-line developments and is properly documented with capitalization reports and sharing of lessons learnt.

**Contribute to the Energy, HVAC, & Cold Chain Team Leader in 3rd line support tools development, such as**

- Guidelines for the design and maintenance of HVAC and Cold Chain settings and active cold chain equipment
- HVAC and Cold Chain technical training
- Follow up and supervise outsourced developments
- Job descriptions of HVAC and Cold Chain Referents and Technicians in the projects

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Education & Experience**

- Technical education (refrigeration technician/engineer) in energy, mechanics, or other formal HVAC training
- Minimum of 2 years professional HVAC experience of which minimum of 1 year of experience in a related position
- Experience in coaching and training of staff is an asset
- Certificates in technical maintenance are an asset
- Relevant work experience in health structures is an asset
- Experience in developing countries is an asset
- Experience of working with MSF or another international humanitarian organization is an asset

**Competencies**

- Ability to design and propose HVAC installations, including maintenance, planning, and procurement
- Ability to compare technical specifications of HVAC equipment
- Ability to design & deliver technical training
- Good understanding of sustainable building design (alt. low energy building design, energy-efficient building design, or passive construction energy systems) and insulation techniques
- Good understanding of electricity and electrical safety
- Good knowledge of HVAC design software: HAP, VRV design tools, AutoCAD, etc.…
- Good analytical skills
- Proactive and willing to propose innovative ideas and solutions rapidly
- Ability to work within an agreed timeline and prioritize activities/tasks
- Results, quality & service oriented
- Strong ability to work in a team and to work in a multi-stakeholder environment
- Willing to take measured risks and responsibility for their choices
- Good communication skills: active listener, communicates clearly and effectively, sense of diplomacy
- Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and contexts
- Strong intercultural awareness and adaptability

**Languages**

- Proficient level in English and French, both oral and written is mandatory
- Other commonly used languages in MSF (Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese) are an asset

**Other**

- Willingness to travel abroad under difficult conditions in sometimes insecure and remote locations

**CONDITIONS**

- Expected start date: As soon as possible
- Location\*: Brussels (Belgium)

\**Due to administrative constraints, given the duration of the contract, candidates may need to already have the permanent right and/or a valid work permit to work in the mentioned locations.*

*\*Other location/s where there is an MSF entity could be discussed in exceptional cases. The outcome will depend on the candidate's residency, the local legal restrictions (residency, work permit, etc.), and the agreement with the host MSF entity of the location.*

- Type of contract: Fixed-term contract – Full-time
- Duration of contract: 1 year (renewable)
- Mobility: up to 70% of the time in MSF projects worldwide
- Salary according to MSF mobile staff salary grid
- High mobility allowance and travel allowance
- The contractual terms, conditions and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate and in respect of MSF standard function and salary grid for mobile staff
- Medical insurance 100% covered as per international package; 45 days annual paid leaves; Accomplishment bonus of 1.5-month salary upon completion of a 12-month contract
- Not a family position
- **Adhere to the MSF principles and our managerial values: Respect, Transparency, Integrity, Accountability, Trust and Empowerment**
- **Comply with the MSF Behavioral Commitments**

**Deadline for applications: November 4th 2026**

jobs.title: Representative for Ukraine
jobs.description:
Status: no-family posting
Location: Kharkiv (main office) with frequent duty travels to Kyiv
Contract duration: 1 year (possibility of extension)
Reports to: Regional Program Coordinator (Geneva-based)
Start date: January / February 2027

**Lutheran World Federation (LWF) World Service (WS)**
World Service is the humanitarian and development arm of the Lutheran World Federation. We are a widely recognized, international, faith-based organization working in over 20 countries. We seek to bring people of all backgrounds together in the common quest for justice, peace, and reconciliation in an increasingly complex and fragmented world. A commitment to the human rights of every individual, regardless of their status, guides our work, actions, and operations. We are particularly known for our timely, compassionate, and professional humanitarian work, and for our field presence in hard-to-reach areas. Our work is people-centred and community-based. Above all, we work with the most vulnerable, and in order to claim and uphold their rights, we engage proactively with local government and community structures. For additional information, please see [LWF World Service](https://lutheranworld.org/WorldService).

Since February 2022, LWF and its partners have been responding to the emergency needs of displaced and war-affected communities in Ukraine, who continue to endure the severe physical and emotional consequences of war and armed conflict. Key priorities are safe shelter construction and repair, humanitarian assistance through distribution of NFI (NonFood Items), education, livelihood and Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS). LWF coordinates and works closely with the Government of Ukraine, local authorities, the LWF member church in Ukraine, ACT Alliance members, civil society organizations, UN agencies (in particular UNHCR) and other relevant actors. The current geographic focus is on the Northeast of Ukraine, particularly the Kharkiv and Sumy regions. For additional information, please see: [LWF Ukraine](https://worldservice.lutheranworld.org/where-we-work/ukraine).

**Purpose**
The Representative (Rep) is the leader of the Lutheran World Federation (LWF) World Service Emergency Operation in Ukraine, with overall responsibility for its strategic direction, management and performance. The role ensures that the program delivers meaningful results for the communities it serves, in line with LWF World Service policies, the Global World Service Strategy and the LWF Ukraine strategy outline. The Rep leads program delivery, organizational growth, compliance, financial oversight, resource mobilization and staff development, and sets and reviews strategic direction in an accountable, participatory way. As LWF’s principal representative in Ukraine, the Representative builds strong relationships with government authorities, other ACT members, donors, UN agencies, churches and civil society, and promotes LWF’s values, mission and visibility.

**Required qualifications**
Master’s degree in International Development, Humanitarian Affairs, International Relations, Social Sciences or another relevant field.

**Knowledge and Experience**
Minimum of seven (7) years' experience in emergency/humanitarian programming and recovery and development programming.
Minimum of five (5) years of successful experience in a senior leadership/management position in the field of humanitarian response, within an international organisation.
Knowledge of and experience in cooperating with governments, the United Nations system and inter-agency coordination clusters and other coordination structures at national level.
Strong financial and hands-on operational management experience.
Proven experience in resource mobilization and donor engagement.
Experience in working with local partners and capacity strengthening
Experience working in fragile and volatile security contexts.
Knowledge of LWF, its member churches, ACT Alliance members and related agencies is an asset.

Given the operational context, the successful candidate will need to travel regularly and, at times, on short notice. Applicants should carefully consider their ability to secure the necessary travel documentation and access required to perform the duties of the position.

**Language Skills**
English: Advanced (written, spoken)
Ukrainian and/or Russian would be a real asset

**LWF Core Skills**
Leadership –resource level\*
Working effectively with others –resource level
Accountability –resource level
Analytical thinking –advanced level
Initiative –resource level
Achieving results –resource level

**LWF Functional Skills**
People Management –resource level
Facilitation / Negotiation –resource level
Project Management -advanced level
Networking -resource level
Communication -advanced level

\*LWF 3 skills levels are: basis - advanced - resource

All LWF staff are expected to uphold the values and principles set out in the LWF Code of Conduct, the Core Humanitarian Standard, and relevant organizational policies, including the Protection from Sexual Abuse, Exploitation and Harassment (PSEAH), Safeguarding, and Gender Justice policies. Staff members are expected to conduct themselves, both professionally and personally, in a manner that upholds the values and reputation of the LWF and its humanitarian mission.

The LWF values diversity and is dedicated to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and safe working environment. We welcome applications from qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities.

We thank all the applicants for their interest in joining the LWF. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**Main Duties**

**Leadership and Strategic Direction**
Provides overall leadership to the LWF Ukraine Emergency Operation.
Promotes, implements and upholds the vision, mission, core values and objectives of the global LWF World Service strategy, and guides the strategic direction for the LWF Ukraine emergency operation together with the Regional Program Coordinator.
Leads the Country Management Team and fosters a culture of collaboration, integrity, innovation, learning and continuous improvement.
Raises the profile of LWF World Service as an international humanitarian organization by continuously improving the quality of its work and strategically operating with others.

**Programme Management and Quality**
Ensures programmes align with LWF policies and guidelines, in close collaboration with the Program Coordinator.
Enables the team to deliver effective planning, monitoring, evaluation and reporting (PMER) that is timely, of high quality and compliant with LWF World Service and donor requirements.
Strengthens programme management systems for accountable, effective and high quality delivery, ensuring accountability to affected populations and local communities.
Ensures good management of resources, operations and partnerships with special emphasis on capacity building and continued improvement.
Conducts regular monitoring visits to project sites to provide on-site support and coaching.

**Resource Mobilization and Partnerships**
Develops strategies and operational plans and actively engages in negotiations with key stakeholders to uphold and develop a viable portfolio of projects and programs.
Oversees the development of high-quality concept notes, project proposals and ensures successful execution of grants.
Strengthens partnerships with local and international stakeholders to mobilise (new) resources and joint fundraising.

**Financial Management, Compliance and Risk management**
Ensures efficient, accountable and compliant financial and administrative management, in accordance with the LWF World Service Finance Manual, donor regulations and national legislation.
Works closely with the finance team, fostering close collaboration between finance and programme units, and monitors budget utilization and financial performance to ensure the programme's financial sustainability.
Leads risk management processes and mitigation measures.
Ensures effective internal controls and oversees internal and external audits.

**People Management**
Directly supervises the Program Coordinator, Finance Manager, other senior unit heads and administrative support staff.
Provides regular coaching and mentoring, conducts performance appraisals and builds a competent, cohesive, high performing management team.
Oversees staffing plans, staff development, succession planning and all matters related to national and international staff.
Ensures new staff receive thorough orientation on LWF World Service strategies, policies, organizational culture and their assigned programmes.
Promotes safeguarding, staff wellbeing and a positive, inclusive work environment.

**Representation, Advocacy and Networking**
Serves as the primary representative of LWF in Ukraine and in national networks and coordination forums.
Maintains close, consultative relationships with the LWF member church in Ukraine and other ecumenical and faith-based partners.
Plays an active role in the ACT Alliance Forum, ensuring LWF participation in joint planning, implementation, advocacy and other initiatives.
Maintains regular coordination with government authorities, UN agencies, and international and national NGOs.
Supports evidence-based advocacy aligned with LWF priorities and builds strategic alliances that enhance programme impact and LWF's positioning.

**Safety, Security and Duty of Care**
Ensures effective executive oversight of security and duty of care.
Ensures implementation of LWF security policies and procedures.
Leads crisis management and emergency preparedness.
Promotes staff safety, security and wellbeing.
Ensures business continuity measures are maintained and updated.

**Other Duties**
Performs other duties as assigned by the direct supervisor (the Regional Program Coordinator based in Geneva).

**Major challenges**
Based in a highly volatile and insecure environment, the position holder will maintain program quality and accountability, motivate and retain staff, and ensure financial stability as conditions can change abruptly.

jobs.title: Logistics Assistant-National Position
jobs.description:
**English**

**Description of the mission**:

Expertise France is the French international technical assistance agency, created from the merger of the six main French public implementing agencies on 1 January 2015, in order to enhance capacities to mobilize technical expertise, making it possible to address the growing needs of emerging and developing countries more effectively. Under the joint supervision of the Ministry of European and Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Economy, within the AFD GROUP, Expertise France aims at participating in French cooperation and development aid through a wide range of interventions in areas such as sustainable development, economic development, public finances, governance and human rights, social protection and employment, health, and issues of stability, safety and security.

Expertise France is accredited by the European Commission for delegated management (the 'six pillars' audit), which means it can be awarded indirect management of projects and guarantees EF's capacity to successfully implement activities and projects with which it is entrusted, and ensure efficient distribution of administrative, hr and financial management tasks.

**1. Position Purpose**

The Logistics Assistant will provide effective administrative and operational support to the Logistics Department, with a strong focus on asset management, documentation and filing, vehicle movement planning, travel arrangements, and coordination of logistics requirements with projects and departments. The position requires a highly organized, detail-oriented individual with strong coordination and communication skills and excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**Asset Management**

· Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of company assets, including office equipment, furniture, IT equipment, and other assigned assets.

· Support asset registration, tagging, tracking, transfer, handover, and disposal processes :transfers, handovers, disposals after approval by the Liaison and Logistic manage .

· Maintain asset documentation and ensure all records are properly filed and updated.

· Participate in periodic physical inventory check, conducted with Liaison and Logistic Manager

· Prepare asset reports and inventory lists as required for approbation by the Liaison and Logistic Manager Follow up with relevant departments regarding asset movements, transfers, and accountability.

**Filing and Documentation Management**

· Maintain an organized and systematic filing system for logistics-related documents, both electronic and hard copy.

· Ensure contracts, invoices, delivery notes, asset records, vehicle documents, hotel bookings, travel arrangements, and other logistics documentation are properly maintained.

· Ensure documents are easily accessible and appropriately archived.

· Support preparation and organization of documents for audits and internal reviews.

**Vehicle and Car Movement Planning**

· Prepare and draft daily and weekly vehicle movement plans based on staff and project requirements, and submit then for validation by the Liaison and Logistic Manager

· Coordinate vehicle requests and transportation schedules with projects and relevant departments.

· Assign vehicles and drivers according to operational requirements and movement plans approved by the Liaison and Logistics Manager.

· Monitor daily vehicle movements and ensure transportation arrangements are clearly communicated to drivers and staff.

· Coordinate airport pick-ups, drop-offs, field movements, meetings, and other transportation requirements.

· Maintain accurate records of vehicle usage, movements, mileage, and related information.

· Coordinate with vehicle rental companies and drivers regarding transportation requirements and operational issues.

· Immediately report any incident or security concern to the Liaison and Logistics Manager

**Travel and Accommodation Coordination**

· Coordinate with projects and departments to arrange hotel bookings, flight bookings, airport transportation, and other travel-related logistics requirements.

· Support travel arrangements for staff, consultants, experts, visitors, and project personnel.

· Coordinate with hotels, travel agencies, airlines, and other service providers as required.

· Make travel arrangements in accordance with organizational policies and approved requests, and refere any exception to the Logistics Manager

· Maintain accurate records of travel bookings, confirmations, invoices, and related documentation.

· Follow up on changes, cancellations, extensions, and other travel requirements.

**Project Logistics Support**

· Coordinate closely with project teams to understand and respond to their logistics requirements.

· Provide timely support for meetings, workshops, trainings, conferences, field visits, and other project activities.

· Coordinate transportation, accommodation, venues, equipment, supplies, and other logistical arrangements.

· Ensure project logistics requests are properly documented, followed up, and completed within required timelines.

· Maintain effective communication with projects and internal departments regarding the status of logistics arrangements.

**General Logistics Support**

· Support procurement and service arrangements related to logistics activities when required.

· Obtain quotations and coordinate with suppliers and service providers as assigned, in line with procurement procedures

· Follow up on invoices, payments, and supporting documents related to logistics services, and submit them to the Liaison and Logistics manager for verification.

· Prepare logistics reports, trackers, schedules, and other required documentation.

· Support the Logistics Manager with daily operational and administrative tasks.

· Apply organizational policies, procedures, and security requirements and report any deviation to the manager

**3. Required Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

· 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in logistics, administration, transportation, asset management, travel coordination, or a related field.

· Strong practical experience in asset management and inventory control.

· Experience preparing and managing vehicle movement plans and transportation arrangements.

· Experience coordinating hotel and flight bookings and travel arrangements.

· Experience working with project teams and managing multiple logistics requests simultaneously.

**4. Required Skills and Competencies**

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

· Excellent organizational and filing skills.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Strong planning, coordination, and follow-up skills.

· Ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure.

· Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines simultaneously.

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

· Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.

· Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

· High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

· Ability to maintain confidentiality of organizational and staff information.

**5. Preferred Experience**

· Experience working in an international organization, NGO, development organization, or project-based environment.

· Experience working with vehicle rental companies, hotels, airlines, travel agencies, and other logistics service providers.

· Experience maintaining electronic databases, trackers, and asset management systems.

· Knowledge of logistics procedures, policies, and documentation standards.

**French:**

**Description de la mission**

Expertise France est l’agence française de coopération technique internationale, créée le 1er janvier 2015 à la suite de la fusion des six principaux opérateurs publics français de coopération technique, afin de renforcer les capacités de mobilisation de l’expertise technique et de répondre plus efficacement aux besoins croissants des pays émergents et en développement.

Placée sous la tutelle conjointe du ministère de l’Europe et des Affaires étrangères et du ministère de l’Économie, au sein du GROUPE AFD, Expertise France contribue à la coopération française et à l’aide au développement à travers un large éventail d’interventions dans des domaines tels que le développement durable, le développement économique, les finances publiques, la gouvernance et les droits humains, la protection sociale et l’emploi, la santé, ainsi que les enjeux de stabilité, de sûreté et de sécurité.

Expertise France est accréditée par la Commission européenne pour la gestion indirecte (audit des « six piliers »). Cette accréditation lui permet de se voir confier la gestion indirecte de projets et atteste de sa capacité à mettre en œuvre efficacement les activités et les projets qui lui sont confiés, ainsi qu’à assurer une répartition efficiente des tâches de gestion administrative, des ressources humaines et des finances.

**1. Objectif du poste**

L’Assistant(e) logistique apporte un appui administratif et opérationnel efficace au Département logistique, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur la gestion des biens et équipements, la documentation et l’archivage, la planification des déplacements des véhicules, l’organisation des voyages et la coordination des besoins logistiques avec les projets et les différents départements.

Ce poste requiert une personne très organisée, soucieuse du détail, dotée de solides compétences en coordination et en communication, ainsi que d’une excellente maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office.

**2. Principales responsabilités**

**Gestion des biens et équipements**

- Tenir des registres précis et régulièrement mis à jour des biens de l’organisation, notamment le matériel de bureau, le mobilier, les équipements informatiques et les autres biens attribués.
- Contribuer aux procédures d’enregistrement, d’étiquetage, de suivi, de transfert, de remise et de mise au rebut des biens, ces opérations étant soumises à l’approbation préalable du Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité.
- Assurer la gestion documentaire relative aux biens et veiller à ce que tous les dossiers soient correctement classés et mis à jour.
- Participer aux inventaires physiques périodiques réalisés en collaboration avec le Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité.
- Préparer les rapports relatifs aux biens et les listes d’inventaire, selon les besoins, pour approbation par le Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité.
- Assurer le suivi auprès des départements concernés des mouvements de biens, des transferts et de la responsabilisation des personnes auxquelles les biens sont confiés.

**Gestion du classement et de la documentation**

- Tenir un système de classement organisé et méthodique pour les documents liés à la logistique, en version électronique et papier.
- Veiller à la bonne conservation des contrats, factures, bons de livraison, registres des biens, documents relatifs aux véhicules, réservations hôtelières, dossiers de voyage et autres documents logistiques.
- Garantir l’accessibilité des documents et leur archivage approprié.
- Contribuer à la préparation et à l’organisation des documents nécessaires aux audits et aux contrôles internes.

**Planification des déplacements des véhicules**

- Préparer et élaborer les plans quotidiens et hebdomadaires de déplacement des véhicules en fonction des besoins du personnel et des projets, puis les soumettre à la validation du Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité.
- Coordonner les demandes de véhicules et les horaires de transport avec les équipes projet et les départements concernés.
- Affecter les véhicules et les chauffeurs en fonction des besoins opérationnels et des plans de déplacement approuvés par le Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité.
- Suivre les déplacements quotidiens des véhicules et veiller à ce que les modalités de transport soient clairement communiquées aux chauffeurs et au personnel.
- Coordonner les transferts vers et depuis l’aéroport, les déplacements sur le terrain, les trajets liés aux réunions et les autres besoins de transport.
- Tenir des registres précis de l’utilisation des véhicules, de leurs déplacements, du kilométrage et des informations connexes.
- Coordonner avec les sociétés de location de véhicules et les chauffeurs les besoins de transport et les éventuels problèmes opérationnels.
- Signaler immédiatement tout incident ou toute préoccupation liée à la sécurité au Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité.

**Coordination des voyages et de l’hébergement**

- Coordonner avec les projets et les départements les réservations d’hôtels, de vols, les transferts aéroportuaires et les autres besoins logistiques liés aux déplacements.
- Apporter un appui à l’organisation des déplacements du personnel, des consultants, des experts, des visiteurs et des équipes projet.
- Assurer la coordination avec les hôtels, les agences de voyages, les compagnies aériennes et les autres prestataires de services, selon les besoins.
- Organiser les déplacements conformément aux politiques de l’organisation et aux demandes approuvées, et soumettre toute dérogation à l’approbation du Responsable logistique.
- Tenir des registres précis des réservations de voyage, des confirmations, des factures et des documents connexes.
- Assurer le suivi des modifications, annulations, prolongations et autres besoins liés aux déplacements.

**Appui logistique aux projets**

- Travailler en étroite coordination avec les équipes projet afin de comprendre leurs besoins logistiques et d’y répondre.
- Fournir un appui rapide et adapté à l’organisation des réunions, ateliers, formations, conférences, visites de terrain et autres activités des projets.
- Coordonner les transports, l’hébergement, la réservation des salles, les équipements, les fournitures et les autres dispositions logistiques.
- Veiller à ce que les demandes logistiques des projets soient correctement documentées, suivies et traitées dans les délais requis.
- Assurer une communication efficace avec les équipes projet et les départements internes concernant l’état d’avancement des dispositions logistiques.

**Appui logistique général**

- Contribuer, si nécessaire, aux procédures d’achat et à l’organisation des prestations liées aux activités logistiques.
- Recueillir des devis et assurer la coordination avec les fournisseurs et les prestataires de services qui lui sont assignés, conformément aux procédures d’achat.
- Assurer le suivi des factures, des paiements et des pièces justificatives relatifs aux prestations logistiques, puis les soumettre au Responsable de la liaison logistique et de la sécurité pour vérification.
- Préparer les rapports logistiques, les tableaux de suivi, les plannings et toute autre documentation requise.
- Assister le Responsable logistique dans les tâches opérationnelles et administratives quotidiennes.
- Appliquer les politiques, les procédures et les exigences de sécurité de l’organisation, et signaler au responsable tout écart constaté.

**3. Qualifications requises**

- Être titulaire d’un diplôme de licence (Bac+3) en logistique, gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, administration des affaires, management ou dans un domaine connexe.
- Justifier de trois à cinq ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente en logistique, administration, transport, gestion des biens, coordination des voyages ou dans un domaine similaire.
- Posséder une solide expérience pratique en gestion des biens et en contrôle des stocks.
- Avoir une expérience dans l’élaboration et la gestion des plans de déplacement des véhicules et des dispositifs de transport.
- Avoir une expérience dans la coordination des réservations d’hôtels, de vols et des autres modalités de voyage.
- Avoir une expérience de travail avec des équipes projet et être capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs demandes logistiques.

**4. Compétences et aptitudes requises**

- Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
- Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Excel, Word et PowerPoint.
- Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et de classement.
- Grande attention aux détails et souci de l’exactitude.
- Solides capacités de planification, de coordination et de suivi.
- Capacité à hiérarchiser les tâches et à travailler sous pression.
- Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs demandes et échéances.
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles.
- Bonnes capacités de résolution des problèmes et de prise de décision.
- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome ainsi qu’en équipe.
- Grand sens de l’intégrité, de la responsabilité et du professionnalisme.
- Capacité à préserver la confidentialité des informations relatives à l’organisation et au personnel.

**5. Expérience souhaitée**

- Expérience au sein d’une organisation internationale, d’une ONG, d’une organisation de développement ou dans un environnement axé sur la mise en œuvre de projets.
- Expérience de travail avec des sociétés de location de véhicules, des hôtels, des compagnies aériennes, des agences de voyages et d’autres prestataires de services logistiques.
- Expérience dans la tenue de bases de données électroniques, de tableaux de suivi et de systèmes de gestion des biens.
- Connaissance des procédures, des politiques et des normes documentaires en matière de logistique.

**Fixed term | 6 months | ASAP**

## Acted

***Who we are***

Acted works with 19 million people across 43 countries at the intersection of humanitarian, development, climate and environmental programming. We draw on deep contextual knowledge and embrace emerging technologies to save lives, alleviate suffering, and protect and restore our planet. Working in collaboration with a growing ecosystem of local, national and international partners, we pursue one shared objective: a 3Zero World – Zero Exclusion, Zero Carbon and Zero Poverty.

***Who we are looking for***

You bring the core competencies required for classical humanitarian and development work, alongside an active climate and environmental conscience, and you can navigate the challenges that arise when human and environmental suffering intersect. You have an entrepreneurial mindset: you see opportunities, connect dots, adapt your approach to different environments, and take measured risks in pursuit of results. You balance principles with pragmatism, and ambition with humility.

## Acted Occupied Palestinian Territory - OPT

Acted has been present in the West Bank since 2007 and in the Gaza Strip since 2008. With its office in Jerusalem, Acted has been responding to humanitarian needs and development challenges in the Occupied Palestinian Territory through an integrated approach. In view of the worsening of the humanitarian situation in recent years, and even more so since 7 October 2023, Acted is mobilized to respond to the basic needs of the populations affected by the conflict.

## You will be in charge of

The Technical Coordinator is responsible for the provision of coordination and support as well as strategic planning and technical guidance on activities. He/She plays a leading role in providing technical inputs to the strategy and project development at the local and national level. Moreover, he/she supports the Project Teams in the planning, design, implementation, supervision, and potential expansion/development and administration of technica interventions.

***Main duties***

1\. External Positioning

- *External Relations*
- *Project Development*

2\. Internal Technical Support and Coordination

- *Coordination*
- *Technical Leadership*
- *Staff Capacity Building*

## Expected skills and qualifications

- Degree in relevant field of expertise;
- At least 5 years of experience in project implementation on the field, preferably in an international context;
- Being a strong team player;
- Familiarity with the aid system, and ability to understand donor and governmental requirement;
- Excellent communication and drafting skills;
- Ability to coordinate and manage staff and project activities;
- Proven ability to work creatively and independently both in the field and in the office;
- Ability to organize and plan effectively;
- Ability to work with culturally diverse groups of people;
- Ability to travel and work in difficult conditions and under pressure;
- Fluent English skills required;
- Knowledge of local language and/or regional experience is an asset.

## Terms of reference

For more information about the position, [click here ](https://www.acted.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/tc-early-recovery-opt-2026.pdf).

## Conditions

- Salary between 3200 and 3400€ monthly (before income tax), depending on the level of education, security level, etc as well as a monthly living allowance of $300
- Accommodation and food provided in Acted guesthouse
- Pension, health insurance, life insurance and repatriation assistance (& unemployment insurance for EU citizens)
- Flight tickets every 6 months & visa fees covered
- Contribution to the luggage transportation: up to 100 kgs, depending on the length of the contract
- Rest & Recuperation (R&R) every 2 months, flight tickets covered up to $500 and allowance of $200
- Annual leave of 25 to 43 days per year
- One week pre-departure training in Acted HQ, including a 4-days in situ security training
- Tax advice (free 30-minute call with a tax consultant)
- Psychological assistance
- This position is classified as an **international staff position** under Acted’s recruitment framework. Eligibility for an international contract is therefore required.

jobs.title: Program Officer (Damascus) - Multi Sector Project Manager
jobs.description:
## **Location: Damascus, Syria**

## **Background:**

Woman Support Association is a humanitarian, developmental, and nongovernmental organization that was established in 2013 and officially registered in Turkey in 2015. All projects implemented by the Association in Syria and Turkey aim to build a better life for women and empower them so that they can face problems and challenges in a way that maintains their dignity and respect.

## Job Purpose

Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering property development, building rehabilitation, refurbishment, renovation, and improvement projects from feasibility and concept design through construction, completion, and handover.

The role ensures that projects are delivered safely, within approved budgets and timelines, to the required quality standards, and in compliance with applicable building regulations, planning requirements, environmental standards, and organizational policies.

The Project Manager will coordinate consultants, contractors, internal departments, regulatory authorities, and other stakeholders to maximize project value, maintain asset quality, and achieve the organization's development objectives.

## **Duties & Responsibilities:**

**A. Project Development and Planning**

- Identify and assess development, redevelopment, rehabilitation, and refurbishment opportunities.
- Conduct or coordinate feasibility studies, site assessments, condition surveys, and preliminary cost estimates.
- Develop project briefs, scopes of work, implementation plans, budgets, and delivery schedules.
- Coordinate architectural designs, engineering solutions, specifications, and technical documentation.
- Review design proposals to ensure functionality, cost-effectiveness, sustainability, and compliance with project requirements.
- Establish project objectives, performance indicators, milestones, and risk management plans.

**B. Rehabilitation and Refurbishment Management**

- Assess the condition of existing buildings, facilities, and infrastructure to determine rehabilitation requirements.
- Develop rehabilitation strategies and prioritize works based on safety, condition, operational needs, and available funding.
- Manage structural repairs, building upgrades, MEP (mechanical, electrical, and plumbing) works, interior refurbishment, and other improvement activities as applicable.
- Coordinate remedial works, defect resolution, and the upgrading of existing facilities to meet current standards.
- Ensure appropriate consideration of occupied buildings, business continuity, access, utilities, and disruption to existing users.
- Monitor rehabilitation works to ensure that approved technical specifications and quality standards are achieved.

**C. Project Execution and Delivery**

- Manage the full project lifecycle, from initiation and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
- Coordinate contractors, architects, engineers, quantity surveyors, project consultants, and other service providers.
- Monitor project progress against approved schedules, budgets, and contractual milestones.
- Conduct site inspections and progress meetings to identify delays, technical issues, and corrective actions.
- Review and manage variations, change requests, extensions of time, and other project changes in accordance with delegated authority.
- Resolve project implementation challenges and escalate significant risks and decisions when necessary.

**D. Budget and Cost Management**

- Prepare and monitor project budgets, cash-flow forecasts, cost plans, and expenditure reports.
- Review bills of quantities, estimates, tender submissions, valuations, and payment recommendations.
- Track actual expenditure against approved budgets and identify potential cost overruns.
- Recommend cost optimization measures without compromising safety, quality, or project functionality.
- Support financial forecasting, funding requests, and project business cases.
- Ensure that expenditure and commitments comply with approved budgets and procurement procedures.

**E. Procurement and Contract Administration**

- Prepare scopes of work, technical requirements, tender documents, and contractor evaluation criteria.
- Coordinate procurement activities and support the appointment of qualified consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
- Administer project contracts in coordination with the commercial, procurement, and legal teams.
- Monitor contractor performance, deliverables, contractual obligations, and compliance.
- Review claims, variations, progress certificates, and completion documentation as authorized.
- Maintain transparent procurement records and support fair, competitive, and compliant tender processes.
- selection where appropriate.

**F. Stakeholder and Team Management**

- Coordinate internal departments, consultants, contractors, tenants, property users, authorities, and other stakeholders.
- Lead project meetings and communicate progress, risks, decisions, and required actions.
- Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve project-related conflicts.
- Coordinate approvals, permits, inspections, and regulatory submissions.
- Provide clear project updates to senior management and relevant governance committees.
- Foster accountability, collaboration, and effective communication among project teams.

**G. Reporting, Handover, and Post-Completion**

- Prepare periodic reports on project progress, costs, schedule, quality, risks, and performance.
- Maintain accurate project records, approvals, drawings, contracts, instructions, and correspondence.
- Coordinate testing, commissioning, practical completion inspections, and snagging.
- Ensure completion of defects liability obligations and outstanding corrective works.
- Coordinate handover of completed facilities, including as-built drawings, warranties, operation and maintenance manuals, and asset registers.
- Conduct post-completion reviews and document lessons learned to improve future project delivery.

### **Competencies, Skills & Experience:**

- At least three years’ experience in humanitarian work of the NW Syria context in I/ NGOs
- At least three years’ experience in managing girls and women protection projects in I/ NGOs
- (Or) At least three years’ experience in managing FSL Projects in I/ NGOs
- (Or) At least three years’ experience in managing Development and Rehabilitation Projects in I/ NGOs
- (Or) At least three years’ experience in managing WASH Projects in I/ NGOs
- Proven experience in leading a team
- Good in MS Office programs (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
- Good understanding of and engagement with the humanitarian context and the key principles of accountability, impartiality, neutrality, independence and cooperation;
- Ability to operate as part of a team in a multi-cultural, value-driven work environment, and to perform tasks in sensitivity to the local culture;
- Excellent analytical/problem-solving skills and detail orientation with adaptable communication skills
- Ability to work under pressure and punctuality.
- Good organizational skills, time management skills, and setting work priorities
- Ability to negotiate, learn and self-develop.
- Ability to work overtime when needed
- Very good at English Speaking / writing

### **Education:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or any related field.
- (Preferred) Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or any related field.

## **Terms and Conditions:**

**Safeguarding:**

Children and vulnerable adults must be safeguarded to the maximum possible extent from deliberate or inadvertent actions and failings that place them at risk of abuse, sexual exploitation, injury and any other harm. One of the ways that WSA shows this on-going commitment to safeguarding is to include rigorous background and reference checks in the selection process for all candidates.

**PSEAH**:

WSA adheres to all laws and standards to reduce cases of sexual exploitation and harassment, and obliges all their employees and suppliers to undergo the necessary training on the policies adopted by PSEAH network.

jobs.title: Project Assistant - National Position
jobs.description:
**English:**

**Description of the mission**:

Expertise France is the French international technical assistance agency, created from the merger of the six main French public implementing agencies on 1 January 2015, in order to enhance capacities to mobilize technical expertise, making it possible to address the growing needs of emerging and developing countries more effectively. Under the joint supervision of the Ministry of European and Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Economy, within the AFD GROUP, Expertise France aims at participating in French cooperation and development aid through a wide range of interventions in areas such as sustainable development, economic development, public finances, governance and human rights, social protection and employment, health, and issues of stability, safety and security.

Expertise France is accredited by the European Commission for delegated management (the 'six pillars' audit), which means it can be awarded indirect management of projects and guarantees EF's capacity to successfully implement activities and projects with which it is entrusted, and ensure efficient distribution of administrative, HR and financial management tasks.

**Project name and description**:

The technical assistance project to support inclusive reforms of Jordan’s civil service, is implemented by Expertise France through a resident project team based within the Country Office in Amman. The overall objective of the project:

The main Jordanian authorities will efficaciously implement the Public sector modernization reforms, focusing on the PSMR and the HRM by-law, taking into account the promotion of effective women and men equality into the State's human resources.

Project Components

· Component 1: Strengthening the institutional and strategic capacities of leading public institutions coordinating the implementation of the roadmap for modernizing Jordan's public sector.

· Component 2: Supporting an inclusive and efficient civil service through the effective implementation of human resources reform that integrates professional equality

The Project Assistant will provide efficient administrative, logistical, and financial support for the Project Manager. Therefore, he/she works closely with the PSU. He/she will undertake the following tasks and responsibilities:

1\. Initiate and follow up on the procurement process:

· Assist the program team with the contracting process of experts and/or service providers (preparing purchase requests, collect program signatures etc.).

· Liaise with the Support Services Unit (Projects Support Unit) for all procurements and follow up on the procurement process and contract signature with the PSU.

2\. Administrative support:

· Take care of administrative arrangements for conferences, seminars, training sessions, meetings and other project-related activities and events, including the preparation of memos, letters, invitations, and visibility material, publication of announcements;

· Coordinate with the PSU on the travel procedures by requesting hotel accommodations, and transportation for staff and experts to the PSU

· Assist with formatting documents, presentations, and correspondence;

· Provide occasional support with translation/interpretation, assist in preparation for activities;

· Support on calendar and meetings organization of the Inclusive reforms project.

· Support on the project manager’s documentations when required.

3\. Documentation and reporting:

· Support the preparation of project reports and documentation for Headquarters and donors;

· Participate in regular team meetings and contribute to discussions on logistical and financial aspects;

· Archive key documents and correspondence systematically;

· Maintain an inventory of items purchased by the Project;

· Contribute to the Procedure Manual of the Project;

· Manage and regularly update a contact database, including information on key stakeholders, suppliers and partners;

· Liaise with the Support Services Unit (Projects Support Unit) on the database for procurements list of suppliers, and locations of various logistical elements.

4\. Payments and accounting support for the *Inclusive Reforms* project :

· Collect Operational advances from the PSU and proceed with cash payments when required

· Collect all the needed supporting documents and submit it to the PSU for operation advance closure

· Check and review the accounting records shared by the PSU and address any comments or required corrections

· Contribute to monitoring budgetary execution as requested by the *Inclusive Reforms* Project Manager.

**Reporting and supervision**

· Operational and direct supervision from the Project Manager for Inclusive Reforms;

· Interaction with the USP and Country Director

Others:

· Undertake any other duties as assigned by the line manager.

**Qualifications and competences**:

· Bachelor’s degree in social science studies, ex: Business Administration, logistical studies, etc.

· Providing a solid foundation in organizational management, administrative procedures, and financial principles and monitoring budgetary execution.

· At least 3 years' experience in a similar position;

· Ability to work fully in French and/or English;

· Practical exposure to procurement processes, including preparation of purchase requests, follow-up on procurement procedures, and coordination with support units.

· Good knowledge of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.), and AI tools.

· Excellent written and oral communication skills in both English and Arabic – French is an asset.

· Basics knowledge on using operational systems for ex: Quantum, Iris, etc.

· Familiarity with EF procedures and public procurement processes is an asset;

· Knowledge of international donors’ rules, especially EU regulations is an advantage.

**Professional experience**:

· Experience in administrative and operational support, including document preparation meeting coordination, and logistical arrangements for events and project activities.

· Excellent knowledge of procurement principles and processes;

· Good financial and accounting skills;

· Previous similar experience in international technical assistance or cooperation projects;

· Strong work capacity, rigor, and organisation;

· Excellent team player and detail-oriented.

· -

**Interpersonal and Soft Skills**

· Strong organizational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail;

· Availability, flexibility, and autonomy;

· Proactive, problem-solving skills;

· Teamwork and coordination skills with excellent interpersonal abilities;

· Ability to communicate well and reach out, both verbally and in writing, with a wide range of stakeholders including with high-level policy makers;

· Ability to work under pressure in a multicultural environment.

**French:**

**Description de la mission**

Expertise France est l’agence française de coopération technique internationale, créée le 1er janvier 2015 à la suite de la fusion des six principaux opérateurs publics français de coopération technique, afin de renforcer les capacités de mobilisation de l’expertise technique et de répondre plus efficacement aux besoins croissants des pays émergents et en développement.

Placée sous la tutelle conjointe du ministère de l’Europe et des Affaires étrangères et du ministère de l’Économie, au sein du GROUPE AFD, Expertise France contribue à la coopération française et à l’aide au développement à travers un large éventail d’interventions dans des domaines tels que le développement durable, le développement économique, les finances publiques, la gouvernance et les droits humains, la protection sociale et l’emploi, la santé, ainsi que les enjeux de stabilité, de sûreté et de sécurité.

Expertise France est accréditée par la Commission européenne pour la gestion indirecte (audit des « six piliers »). Cette accréditation lui permet de se voir confier la gestion indirecte de projets et atteste de sa capacité à mettre en œuvre efficacement les activités et les projets qui lui sont confiés, ainsi qu’à assurer une répartition efficiente des tâches de gestion administrative, des ressources humaines et des finances.

**Nom et description du projet**

Le projet d’assistance technique visant à soutenir des réformes inclusives de la fonction publique jordanienne est mis en œuvre par Expertise France au moyen d’une équipe projet résidente, basée au sein du bureau pays à Amman.

**Objectif global du projet :**

Les principales autorités jordaniennes mettront en œuvre efficacement les réformes de modernisation du secteur public, en mettant l’accent sur la feuille de route pour la modernisation du secteur public (PSMR) et le règlement relatif à la gestion des ressources humaines (HRM), tout en intégrant la promotion d’une égalité effective entre les femmes et les hommes dans la gestion des ressources humaines de l’État.

**Composantes du projet**

- **Composante 1 :** Renforcer les capacités institutionnelles et stratégiques des principales institutions publiques chargées de coordonner la mise en œuvre de la feuille de route pour la modernisation du secteur public jordanien.
- **Composante 2 :** Soutenir une fonction publique inclusive et efficace grâce à la mise en œuvre effective d’une réforme de la gestion des ressources humaines intégrant l’égalité professionnelle.

L’Assistant(e) de projet apportera un soutien administratif, logistique et financier efficace au Chef de projet. À ce titre, il/elle travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’Unité d’appui aux projets (PSU) et assumera les tâches et responsabilités suivantes :

**1. Lancement et suivi des procédures d’achat**

- Assister l’équipe du programme dans les procédures de contractualisation des experts et/ou des prestataires de services, notamment en préparant les demandes d’achat et en recueillant les signatures nécessaires auprès de l’équipe du programme.
- Assurer la liaison avec l’Unité des services d’appui (Unité d’appui aux projets – PSU) pour l’ensemble des achats et assurer le suivi des procédures d’achat et de la signature des contrats en coordination avec la PSU.

**2. Appui administratif**

- Assurer les préparatifs administratifs des conférences, séminaires, sessions de formation, réunions et autres activités et événements liés au projet, notamment la préparation de notes de service, de courriers, d’invitations et de supports de visibilité, ainsi que la publication d’annonces.
- Coordonner avec la PSU les procédures de déplacement, notamment les demandes de réservation d’hébergement et de transport pour le personnel et les experts.
- Contribuer à la mise en forme des documents, des présentations et de la correspondance.
- Apporter ponctuellement un appui en matière de traduction et d’interprétation, ainsi qu’à la préparation des activités.
- Contribuer à la gestion de l’agenda et à l’organisation des réunions du projet « Réformes inclusives ».
- Apporter, si nécessaire, un appui à la gestion et à l’organisation de la documentation du Chef de projet.

**3. Documentation et reporting**

- Contribuer à la préparation des rapports et de la documentation du projet destinés au siège et aux bailleurs de fonds.
- Participer aux réunions régulières de l’équipe et contribuer aux discussions relatives aux aspects logistiques et financiers.
- Assurer l’archivage systématique des documents essentiels et de la correspondance.
- Tenir à jour l’inventaire des biens et équipements achetés dans le cadre du projet.
- Contribuer à l’élaboration du manuel de procédures du projet.
- Gérer et mettre régulièrement à jour une base de données de contacts comprenant les informations relatives aux principales parties prenantes, aux fournisseurs et aux partenaires.
- Assurer la liaison avec l’Unité des services d’appui (PSU) concernant la base de données des fournisseurs, les listes liées aux achats et la localisation des différents éléments logistiques.

**4. Appui aux paiements et à la comptabilité du projet « Réformes inclusives »**

- Retirer les avances opérationnelles auprès de la PSU et procéder aux paiements en espèces lorsque cela est nécessaire.
- Rassembler l’ensemble des pièces justificatives requises et les transmettre à la PSU pour la clôture des avances opérationnelles.
- Vérifier et examiner les documents comptables transmis par la PSU, puis traiter les observations formulées et effectuer les corrections nécessaires.
- Contribuer au suivi de l’exécution budgétaire à la demande du Chef de projet « Réformes inclusives ».

**Rattachement hiérarchique et supervision**

- Supervision opérationnelle et directe assurée par le Chef de projet « Réformes inclusives ».
- Interaction avec l’Unité des services d’appui (PSU) et le Directeur pays.

**Autres responsabilités**

- Exécuter toute autre tâche confiée par le supérieur hiérarchique direct.

**Qualifications et compétences**

- Être titulaire d’un diplôme de licence (Bac+3) en sciences sociales ou dans un domaine pertinent, tel que l’administration des affaires, la logistique ou un domaine similaire.
- Disposer de solides connaissances en gestion organisationnelle, en procédures administratives et en principes financiers, ainsi qu’en suivi de l’exécution budgétaire.
- Justifier d’au moins trois ans d’expérience dans un poste similaire.
- Être capable de travailler couramment en français et/ou en anglais.
- Avoir une expérience pratique des procédures d’achat, notamment la préparation des demandes d’achat, le suivi des procédures d’acquisition et la coordination avec les unités d’appui.
- Avoir une bonne maîtrise des logiciels Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) ainsi que des outils d’intelligence artificielle.
- Posséder d’excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale en anglais et en arabe ; la connaissance du français constitue un atout.
- Avoir des connaissances de base dans l’utilisation de systèmes opérationnels tels que Quantum, IRIS, etc.
